text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happy come come, fortune arrives~! We did 
it, team! A brilliant victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoooo~! Happy come come! It's a 
victoooryyy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Still, Team <First>... They've leveled up wayyy 
more since then, haven't they?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My hot heart was blazin' up, and it 
was so very exciting~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We did it, we really did it...! We all won 
together...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay, we did it, Rice-chan! You worked so 
hard!

With the team's victory, the Managed 
Training Program will be abolished.

The school's atmosphere of freedom had 
been preserved.

Amidst the ceaseless excitement of the 
stands— Acting President Kashimoto stared 
intently at a single point.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: The result is... our "defeat", is it?
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Kashimotooo! Did you see that?! 
Please listeeeen to meee!"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"We timed our runs this morning! 2 minutes 
24.5 seconds for me, and Little Cocon 
clocked in at 3 minutes 4.8—"

Bitter Glace read out everyone's latest 
times in a single breath.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Everyone beat their target times! And we 
put together a race we can truly be proud 
of! So—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
That is why! Won't you please...! ...Face 
us just once...?!

Before anyone noticed, an out-of-breath 
Little Cocon was standing in the 
bleachers.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
The reason I pushed desperately to beat 
that target time was because I wanted to 
shatter it!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Because you're my precious Trainer... 
Because I love you so much, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why... I want to smash 
those rigid beliefs of yours to 
pieces...!"

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We truly appreciate how well you've 
protected and managed everything for us 
all this time.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Still... from now on...

Having rattled it all out in one breath, 
Little Cocon exhaled as if to calm herself 
down.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, from now on... I want to face you 
properly and aim for victory together."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to be a child who needs to be 
managed; I want to be a partner you can 
rely on.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: I... We feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ………… ...Face it, huh. Yes, you're right...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...I watched the race. It was 
magnificent. It convinced me that I am no 
longer needed."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's—!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
“But just as much as that... I realized I 
wanted to see what lies beyond.”

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: The future that lies ahead for you all.

Acting Director Kashimoto's eyes, once 
clouded in gloom, had regained a small 
spark of light.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Because every single one of them exceeded 
my expectations... and sprinted boldly 
across the turf."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
How long has it been since I last felt 
this way?

She looked out over the post-race track 
with deep affection.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. Without fear, I have to 
place my trust in it."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: About these girls, and about myself.

And with that, Acting Director Kashimoto 
took Little Cocon and headed down to the 
track—down to Team <First>.

The next day, Acting Director Kashimoto 
abolished the control-focused system she 
had promoted and stepped down from her 
post as Acting Director.

Furthermore, due to the possibility of 
future Aoharu Cups and the proven 
effectiveness of team training, it was 
decided that each team would continue to 
exist.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
After sitting down and having a proper 
talk with her, there were so many things I 
came to understand.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...I'll try starting over from scratch 
again.

She had a somewhat calmer demeanor than 
before. She must have found her own 
closure.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to Chairwoman Akikawa's 
kindness, I've been given another 
opportunity to work here as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Next time, on the stage of the Twinkle 
Series, please allow me to challenge you 
and your pupil.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to the day we can face off 
again.

With a faint smile, Acting Director 
Kashimoto quietly left the Trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you done talking, Trainer 
Kashimoto! About tomorrow's training—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait a second! Mine got here first!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...We're in the hallway, both of you. Wait 
until we get to the Trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Don't rush, now. I'll listen to each of 
you properly, one by one."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer Kashimoto!

—The cheerful voices echoing through the 
hallway and the footsteps of the three 
slowly faded into the distance.

By overcoming the past, their future is 
bound to be all the brighter.

Determined to grow before the day they 
meet again as formidable rivals, she 
renewed her resolve.
